nl: ¿Cuántos clientes hay en total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM customers

nl: ¿Cuántos clientes están activos?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM customers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

nl: Lista los 10 productos más caros
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 10 name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos productos están agotados?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM products WHERE stock = 0

nl: Muestra los productos con stock menor a 10
sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock < 10 ORDER BY stock

nl: ¿Cuántas categorías de productos existen?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM categories

nl: Lista las categorías activas
sql: SELECT name FROM categories WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY name

overrides.mssql: SELECT name FROM categories WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY name

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos hay en total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos fueron cancelados?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos se hicieron en 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025

overrides.mssql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025

nl: Muestra los 5 pedidos más recientes
sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, total FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 order_id, order_date, total FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos pagos fueron rechazados?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM payments WHERE status = 'FAILED'

nl: ¿Cuántos envíos están en tránsito?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM shipments WHERE status = 'IN_TRANSIT'

nl: Lista los métodos de pago disponibles
sql: SELECT DISTINCT payment_method FROM payments ORDER BY payment_method

nl: ¿Cuál es el precio promedio de los productos?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS precio_promedio FROM products

nl: ¿Cuántos productos tiene cada categoría?
sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS productos FROM categories cat LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY productos DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos ha hecho cada cliente?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS pedidos FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY pedidos DESC

nl: ¿Cuánto ha gastado cada cliente?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.total), 0) AS gastado FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY gastado DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 10 productos más vendidos por unidades?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 10

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 10 p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles clientes nunca han hecho un pedido?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

nl: ¿Qué productos nunca se han vendido?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL

nl: ¿Cuál es el total de ventas por categoría?
sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS ventas FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY ventas DESC

nl: ¿Cuál es el total vendido por método de pago?
sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total FROM payments WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos tiene cada estado?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY total DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son las 5 ciudades con más clientes?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos clientes hay por país?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY n DESC

nl: ¿Cuál es el ticket promedio por año?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS anio, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) ORDER BY anio

overrides.mssql: SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS anio, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY anio

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos y cuánto se vendió cada mes de 2025?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS mes, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS ventas FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) ORDER BY mes

overrides.mssql: SELECT MONTH(order_date) AS mes, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS ventas FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY mes

nl: ¿Qué clientes tienen más de 3 pedidos?
sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS pedidos FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY pedidos DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles categorías no tienen productos activos?
sql: SELECT cat.name FROM categories cat LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.product_id IS NULL

nl: ¿Cuál es el valor total de inventario por categoría?
sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(p.price * p.stock), 2) AS valor_inventario FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY valor_inventario DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos están pagados pero aún no enviados?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders o JOIN payments pm ON pm.order_id = o.order_id AND pm.status = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED') AND (s.shipment_id IS NULL OR s.status = 'PREPARING')

nl: ¿Cuál es el porcentaje de pedidos cancelados?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_cancelados FROM orders

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 10 clientes con más direcciones registradas?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(a.address_id) AS direcciones FROM customers c LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY direcciones DESC LIMIT 10

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 10 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(a.address_id) AS direcciones FROM customers c LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY direcciones DESC

nl: ¿Cuál es el tiempo promedio entre el envío y la entrega, en días?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(delivery_date, shipment_date)), 2) AS dias_promedio FROM shipments WHERE delivery_date IS NOT NULL

overrides.postgres: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivery_date - shipment_date)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS dias_promedio FROM shipments WHERE delivery_date IS NOT NULL
overrides.mssql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, shipment_date, delivery_date) AS FLOAT)), 2) AS dias_promedio FROM shipments WHERE delivery_date IS NOT NULL

nl: ¿Quién es el cliente que más ha gastado y cuánto?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total) AS gastado FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY gastado DESC LIMIT 1

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 1 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total) AS gastado FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY gastado DESC

nl: Muestra el top 3 de productos más vendidos de cada categoría
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT cat.category_id, cat.name AS categoria, p.name AS producto, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name, p.product_id, p.name) SELECT categoria, producto, unidades FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY categoria, rn

nl: ¿Qué clientes han gastado más que el promedio general?
sql: WITH gasto_cliente AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS gastado FROM orders WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT gc.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, gc.gastado FROM gasto_cliente gc JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = gc.customer_id WHERE gc.gastado > (SELECT AVG(gastado) FROM gasto_cliente) ORDER BY gc.gastado DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 5 clientes con más pedidos entregados?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS entregados FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY entregados DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS entregados FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY entregados DESC

nl: ¿Qué categorías generan más del 15% de las ventas totales?
sql: WITH ventas_categoria AS (SELECT cat.category_id, cat.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS ventas FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name), total_general AS (SELECT SUM(ventas) AS total_ventas FROM ventas_categoria) SELECT vc.name, ROUND(vc.ventas, 2) AS ventas, ROUND(100.0 * vc.ventas / tg.total_ventas, 2) AS pct FROM ventas_categoria vc CROSS JOIN total_general tg WHERE vc.ventas > 0.15 * tg.total_ventas ORDER BY vc.ventas DESC

nl: ¿Qué pedidos tienen un total distinto a la suma de subtotal, impuestos y envío?
sql: SELECT order_id, total, subtotal, tax, shipping_cost FROM orders WHERE total <> ROUND(subtotal + tax + shipping_cost, 2)

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 5 clientes con más productos distintos comprados?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS productos_distintos FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY productos_distintos DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS productos_distintos FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY productos_distintos DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 5 productos con mayor ingreso generado, junto con su categoría?
sql: SELECT p.name, cat.name AS categoria, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS ingreso FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY p.name, cat.name ORDER BY ingreso DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 p.name, cat.name AS categoria, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS ingreso FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY p.name, cat.name ORDER BY ingreso DESC

nl: ¿Qué clientes han comprado productos de más de 5 categorías distintas?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS categorias FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 5 ORDER BY categorias DESC

nl: ¿Qué clientes tienen pagos incompletos frente al total de sus pedidos?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS total_pedidos, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0), 2) AS total_pagado FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' LEFT JOIN payments pm ON pm.order_id = o.order_id AND pm.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(o.total) > COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0) ORDER BY (SUM(o.total) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0)) DESC LIMIT 10

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 10 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS total_pedidos, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0), 2) AS total_pagado FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' LEFT JOIN payments pm ON pm.order_id = o.order_id AND pm.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(o.total) > COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0) ORDER BY (SUM(o.total) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.amount), 0)) DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 3 productos más vendidos dentro de la categoría con mayores ventas?
sql: WITH ventas_por_categoria AS (SELECT cat.category_id, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS ventas FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id), top_categoria AS (SELECT category_id FROM ventas_por_categoria ORDER BY ventas DESC LIMIT 1), productos_ranked AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM top_categoria) GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name, unidades FROM productos_ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY unidades DESC

overrides.mssql: WITH ventas_por_categoria AS (SELECT cat.category_id, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS ventas FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id), top_categoria AS (SELECT TOP 1 category_id FROM ventas_por_categoria ORDER BY ventas DESC), productos_ranked AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM top_categoria) GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name, unidades FROM productos_ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY unidades DESC

nl: ¿Cuántos pedidos superan el promedio de artículos por pedido?
sql: WITH items_por_pedido AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), promedio AS (SELECT AVG(items) AS avg_items FROM items_por_pedido) SELECT COUNT(*) AS pedidos_sobre_promedio FROM items_por_pedido ip CROSS JOIN promedio pr WHERE ip.items > pr.avg_items

nl: ¿Qué clientes han hecho pedidos con envío a más de un país?
sql: SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) AS paises FROM orders o JOIN addresses a ON a.address_id = o.shipping_address_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.country) > 1

nl: ¿Cuál es el precio mínimo, máximo y promedio por categoría?
sql: SELECT cat.name, MIN(p.price) AS min_precio, MAX(p.price) AS max_precio, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS precio_promedio FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY precio_promedio DESC

nl: ¿Cuáles son los 5 clientes con mayor gasto promedio por pedido, considerando solo clientes con más de un pedido?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS pedidos, ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS gasto_promedio FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1 ORDER BY gasto_promedio DESC LIMIT 5

overrides.mssql: SELECT TOP 5 c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS pedidos, ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS gasto_promedio FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1 ORDER BY gasto_promedio DESC
